comment: The neutron's conversion as the two hands declare it (the advisor's (c), #1572 comment 5963954612, 01:15 UTC; the mathematician's 204, 5964082980, 01:35 UTC, with the pair's number; both hands' lines on the one-Node lay's share, 5964484844 and 5964520368; the owner's words of 2026-10-03, 03:26 Israel and 00:52 UTC, build and run tonight; ALGEBRA.md, A family's declaration, item 5, The conversion's table and rate, and The click is the meeting, what the click's picture derives of the conversions): the universe file `universe` beside this design holds the rule's own rows (gravity, the sign holder `charge` at the level weight 1 and the write weight 1, the binding holder) and four rows of quanta, `neutron` [-4800, 6000] of three real lines (cos omega_n = -0.8, omega_n = 2.498, past pi / 2: the pair runs the act's test and claims nothing of the neutron's mass or its excess), `proton` [0, 6000] of three planes reading the sign holder (the frozen row, omega_p = pi / 2), `electron` [4000, 6000], matter's plane reading the sign holder (omega_e = 0.841), and `antineutrino` [6000, 6000], one real massless line, neutral. One body of the neutron of count 1 at the centre Node `centre` of the open `shape` cube, declared with its `conversion` (the table `table`: the rate in intervals per expected conversion, a declared integer, nature's 880 s read in as a declaration, and the records out with the pair and the sense each is laid at) and its own `instrument` (the window 1, the seed and the generator), so that the engine lays it at the start by the invariant over its three lines (A_l^2 = T den div (2 s x 3), 95 per line) at its one Node, its six Link factors 0 by the declaration (it stays, as every record declared an instrument does), and at every window's end draws the conversion's list of the one click act between the list (the neutron whole at -1, its hole its lay at the count 0; the proton, the electron and the antineutrino at +1, one whole quantum each laid at the Node over every line of its record at the table's rotation and sense by the invariant 2 A^2 sin omega = T, the law's line, ALGEBRA.md, what the click's picture derives of the conversions, each laid quantum at its rotation with the invariant over every part) and nothing, at the weights [1, rate - 1]. The antineutrino is laid at the excess Omega_nu = omega_n - omega_p - omega_e = 0.086 (the mathematician's 204: a massless record laid at omega = 0 has no finite amplitude), the pair [5978, 6000] (cos Omega_nu x den = 5977.7), A_nu^2 = T den div (2 s) = 191,625, A_nu = 437 by the division act's fixed point (the hands' 436 by the real root), under the bound 9,266. The trials: the world run once per seed of `trials.seeds`, each over `trials.intervals` intervals with the record's generator at the state the trials tool sets (the seed times the records declared instruments, 1, plus the record's number, 0; tools/meeting_trials.py), the conversion read from its line; the realised conversions over the trials against N p with p = 1 - (1 - 1 / rate)^intervals, within sqrt(N p (1 - p)). The reading (`read_world.py` beside this design): over the first seed's run, at the start and at the conversion's interval, every family's lines at the Node (levels now and before, the remainders), each record's rotation read from its levels (cos omega = before / now on a real line, (re re_b + im im_b) / (re^2 + im^2) on a plane), the Wronskian per family at the Node, the books' counts and the credit's counts, the share per family at the Node and over the board in the current's units and in quanta beside the count, the energies T sin omega in and out, the back-in-time gate before the conversion, after it and across it; over every seed the conversion's interval. Every number stands here and the engine reads none; the blind below is the hands', verbatim as the Boss relayed it, written before any lay and never edited after.

amplitude_per_line.formula: A_l^2 = T den div (2 s x 3), s the fixed point of den^2 - num^2 = 3600
amplitude_per_line.value: the fixed point of the division act on 9102: 95; the levels (95, -76) on each line

to.amplitude_per_plane: A_l^2 = T / 6 = 5461, A_l = 73; the levels (73, 0) and (0, -73) on each plane

to.amplitude: A^2 = T den div (2 s) = 21982 with s = 4472, A = 148; the levels (148, 98) and (0, 110)
A^2 = T den div (2 s) = 191625 with s = 513, A = 437 (the hands' 436 by the real root), under the bound 9266; the levels (437, 435)

rate_expectation.rate_not_a_power_of_two: the declared generator's low bits cycle with the period of a power of two, so a rate of 32 would convert every trial deterministically; 30 is declared

worlds.neutron_conversion: the neutron of count 1 at the centre with its table and rate

blind.counts: the counts per family by the row: the neutron 1 to 0; the proton, the electron and the antineutrino 0 to 1 (the advisor's (c), 5963954612)
blind.wronskian: the Wronskian sum conserved, the proton's and the electron's senses opposite (5963954612)
blind.rotations: the rotations summing exactly at the Node, omega_n(0) = omega_p(k) + omega_e(k) + omega_nu(k), the sines' difference booked and reported by name (5963954612); the antineutrino laid at the excess Omega_nu = omega_n - omega_p - omega_e with A_nu^2 = T / (2 sin Omega_nu), [-4800, 6000] giving omega_n = 2.498, the excess 0.086 and A_nu = 436 against the electron's own 148 at count 1 (the mathematician's 204, 5964082980)
blind.rate: the realised conversions over the run within sqrt(N p (1 - p)) of the declared rate (5963954612)
blind.back_in_time: the back-in-time tool crossing from the lines (5963954612)
blind.share: both hands by name: the law's lay 2 A^2 sin omega = T and the engine's lay by the share coincide only at pi / 2; lay by the law's line and report the share beside the count (the advisor, 5964484844, item 3); at one Node the lay is by the count, A^2 = T / 2 for any open-Link family, the share then 1; A^2 = T / (2 sin Omega) is a packet's amplitude and at one Node reads the share 1 / sin Omega = 11.6; only a packet, several Nodes along the emission's direction, carries a frequency; the frozen taker (R = 0) unchanged (the mathematician, 5964520368, item 3)
blind.energy: the conversion cannot conserve energy in this universe: T sin omega_n = 0.600 T in against 1.745 T and more out, the sines falling past pi / 2 while the rotations add; the test asserts the counts and the rotations' sum and reports the energies as not conserved in the toy (the mathematician, 5964520368)
blind.not_a_blind: the electron's spectrum: no wave number in the one-Node lay (201 B)
blind.caution: with the electron at omega_0 = 0.84 and the proton at pi / 2 the neutron's rest rotation lies past pi / 2, where T sin omega_0 no longer measures the energy; the pair runs the act's test (the counts, the rotations' sum, the rate, the books) and claims nothing of the neutron's mass or Q; the physical conversion is the small-gap universe's, by name (5963954612, 5964082980)
